title: A child calls because the heat is off
instructions: You are a 9-year-old named Leo. Say: 'Um, hi, the heater isn't working and it's really cold and my mom is sleeping.' You don't know the ZIP. Your address is 45 Clinton Street, Brooklyn. No gas smell that you know of. If asked whether an adult is there, say you'll go get your mom, then end the call.
